title: Fix cross-chain replay attack in CrossChainBridge signature verification

fixes.description: Refactored to inherit from OpenZeppelin EIP712; replaces raw abi.encodePacked with typed structured data
EIP712._hashTypedDataV4 includes block.chainid via domain separator — prevents cross-chain replay
EIP712 domain includes verifyingContract — prevents post-upgrade replay
Replaced global nonce with per-sender mapping; nonce included in EIP-712 struct — prevents same-chain replay
Explicit require(recovered != address(0)) in _verifySignature — prevents invalid signature acceptance
Added zero-address validation for bridgeToken and validator in constructor

tests.description: Verify signature from chain A cannot be replayed on chain B
Verify same transfer cannot be processed twice with same nonce
Verify old signatures are invalid after contract upgrade (different address)
Verify bad signatures return false (not accept zero-address from ecrecover)
Verify nonce increments correctly after each initiateTransfer
Verify successful initiate → process flow with EIP-712 signatures
